items.description: Do you have what it takes to become the next President of the United States? Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Make tough decisions as you travel across the country and try to earn enough votes to become the next President of the United States!Campaign Mode:The campaign mode features a thrilling turn-based experience as you counter every move that your opponent makes. Fly to battleground states and conduct polls to see whether you're leading or losing ground. Host political rallies and launch campaign advertisements to try and sway the opinions of undecided voters. Come face to face with your opponent in policy debates, where the fate of the race could hang in the balance. Spend your time wisely in battleground states to try and carve a pathway to winning the electoral college. Avoid gaffes and embarrassing mistakes while on the campaign trail and try to force your opponent into making unforced errors. Do you have what it takes to win the election and become the next President of the United States?Election Night:When the campaign is over, you can experience the intense swings of an American election night. View election results in real-time as the votes are tabulated and watch the results come in for all fifty states throughout the night.Customization:Customize your candidate and represent a major political party. items.description: The 2024 U.S. Election Simulator puts you in control of an American election night like never before. Customize your very own political candidate and run a realistic campaign that spans across the country. Compete in battleground states in an effort to sway the opinion of voters. Make important policy decisions leading up to the election in an effort to appeal to undecided voters.Campaign Mode: The campaign mode allows players to take part in a turn-based campaign where they will have the opportunity to spend their Action Points on various campaign events and media opportunities. Action points can be spent on campaign rallies, television interviews, and campaign advertising. You can also spend money on conducting polls to see how competitive the race is. Throughout the campaign, you'll earn Policy Points, which can be used to unlock important political policies before the election. Every policy could have an impact on certain swing states, which could have an impact on whether the election is won or lost. Game Features: Customize your political candidates and launch your campaign across all 50 states! Carefully manage campaign funds throughout the campaign as you make strategic decisions in each state. Track real-time election night results as the votes get tallied. items.description: Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Participate in debates and travel to battleground states as you try to win a Presidential Election. PRESIDENTIAL CAMPAIGN:Plot your way through an intense campaign of momentum, gaffes, and unexpected surprises. Keep track of the polls and launch national advertising campaigns to stay ahead! Challenge your opponent to policy debates or avoid the debate stage and focus on your own political rallies instead! Take risks throughout your campaign, or play it safe... The choice is yours!Balance your time in each of the battleground states or target reliable states for the other political party to try to unexpectedly flip one of them. Take advantage of gaffes or scandals on each turn of the campaign. Do you have what it takes to win the election and become the next President of the United States?ELECTION NIGHT SIMULATION:When the campaign is over, you can watch the votes get counted in real-time just like a real election night. View election results from battleground states as the ballots are tabulated and watch the results come in for all fifty states as the race to 270 electoral votes intensifies. Watch for key race alerts and important projections in battleground states.NEW 2026 VOTER DATA:Revamped voter data has been integrated into the Simulation Engine to emulate what the 2026 turnout projections are expected to be. Additionally, new voter registration data and election data from recent elections have been implemented into every single state to create the most realistic simulation possible.HISTORICAL ELECTORAL MAPS:Want to play on an old electoral map where the electoral vote values match a historical decade? Play on any electoral map dating back to 1980 and try to face off against the same challenge that some of the greatest American Presidents had to face in their very own elections back in the day.
